content.value: Affleck's repair shop was started on May 1 by B. Affleck. A summary of May (28) transactions is presented below:
2015 May 01 Invested \$10,000 cash to start the repair shop.
2015 May 03 Paid \$400 cash for May office rent.
2015 May 05 Incurred \$250 of advertising costs in the Beacon News on account.
2015 May 06 Received \$4,100 in cash from customers for repair ser vice
2015 May 10 Provided repair service on account to customers \$850.
2015 May 11 Collected cash of \$120 for services billed in transaction (10).
Instruction: Journalize the above transactions in the book of B. Affleck.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
